title: Veilway theme
description: Colour tokens plus glass tint and blur strength. A theme file is at most 16384 bytes. The schema describes the shape; the validator also checks text contrast, on solid surfaces and through the glass over the backdrop these colours make, and may refuse or repair a theme that passes this schema.

bg.description: Page background, the darkest or lightest thing behind the glass

field1.description: First backdrop glow and the colour of the light shafts

surface.description: Solid surface and the scrim of every pane of glass

sunken.description: Inputs, chart frames and other wells cut into glass

accentInk.description: Accent as text or icon on a surface

success.description: Success: a check that passed, a healthy state

warning.description: Warnings and a quota that is nearly used

danger.description: Errors, an unsafe connection and a destructive action

tint.description: Opacity of the scrim of a sheet resting on the backdrop. Raised on import to the lowest value at which text reads through the sheet over this own backdrop of this theme. Navigation, menus and dialogs are denser by a fixed step and a file cannot set them.

blur.description: Backdrop blur of a sheet in CSS pixels. With less blur, layers that float over content are made denser.
